API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementDepartment Resource Update Department
Department Resource Update Department
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/departments/:departmentId

Updates the department for an organization based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
departmentId
int32
REQUIRED

Department ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Department ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Department name

idpId
int64

Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments
string

Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

deleted
boolean

List of deleted departments

Default value: false
